sections.heading: Ben Affleck — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Ben Affleck was born on 15 August 1972 in Berkeley, and holds American nationality. He was given the name Benjamin Geza Affleck-Boldt at birth and is publicly known as Ben Affleck.
Public records name his father, Timothy Byers Affleck and his mother, Christine Anne Boldt. He is a sibling of Casey Affleck.
He received his education at Occidental College, University of Vermont and Cambridge Rindge and Latin School.
He is recorded as speaking English and Spanish.
